Option a opens on an empty room whose door only opens wider (0.8 s). That depicts a declined scan. In option a the phone screen shows a captured code throughout, then the phone lies on the table with no hand. (6) The closing jar with 'owner says' and 'no record shown' is large and legible (57.6 to 60.4 s). Option a's closing tableau is a small wide shot.
